claim: The AWS Backup document history lists "Primary backups to logically air-gapped vaults" on November 17, 2025: logically air-gapped vaults are now supported as a primary backup target, so a single backup copy can be kept. Previously, logically air-gapped vaults could only store copies of existing backups.
question: When could logically air-gapped vaults first be a primary backup target, and what was the earlier rule?

values.display: could only store copies of existing backups

qualifiers.scope: logically air-gapped vault as backup target

changed.was: Previously, logically air-gapped vaults could only store copies of existing backups.
